----Petitioners  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent  Connected With  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 7077/2023 Yunus Khan S/o Rasul Khan, Aged About 40 Years, R/o Pithisar,
Tehsil And Distt. Churu  ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. R.K. Charan  Mr. Himanshu Trivedi
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mahipal Bishnoi, PP assisted by  Mr. C.P. Marwan  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 19/08/2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners.
After hearing learned counsel for the petitioners, I am not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners, hence these bail applications are rejected.

] However, the petitioners are permitted to surrender before the concerned trial court on or before 04.09.2023 and file an application for bail and it is expected from the concerned trial court that the bail application will be decided on the same day.
